claim: *Upload admission must distinguish finite and unlimited entitlement.* The old reduction passed only a finite balance to the client, so an unlimited user was rejected. The revised model records the entitlement kind and returns an admission decision.

alt: Four panels trace a finite-credit model through the introduction of unlimited entitlement, a stale admission model and a revised model. The dashed stale panel shows finite-only summation and an unlimited user reaching 0 less than 38 and REJECT. The strong revised panel preserves finite versus unlimited entitlement and leads to admit_unlimited plus explicit admission fields.
